how_it_works: Form auto-fills person details from login. Location: tick 'Same as in Personal Information' or pick District > Mandal > GS/WS (village secretariat). Grievance: ONE search box 'Search for a Sub Subject' - type a keyword in English, pick 'Department-->Subject-->Sub-subject'. Then Remarks box (required).
privacy_warning: Form shows name, date of birth, house no. Never screenshot or share this part.
